verdict.rationale: Morph is an AI inference and tooling API provider (Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact, Reflexes, and an MCP server for external agents such as Claude Code). A built-in assistant in its dashboard or console is plausible for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The playground mentioned by the community is an apply demo, and the MCP and API integrations serve external agents rather than providing a built-in assistant.
